name: Notifiarr
description: Auto-updater only checks the download URL starts with 'http' (not https), overwrites the running exe, restarts — no hash/signature.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The updater accepts any URL beginning with http and proceeds to replace the executable; no payload integrity check is performed here.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement were not independently verified.
